title: TaskRequest
description: The request payload for a run() or stream() execution. The common envelope (schemaVersion, requestId, task, modelProfile, constraints, preferences, telemetry, authContextRef) is task-agnostic; each task kind owns its payload (ADR 016). text_to_text: at least one of `prompt` (single-turn) or `messages` (multi-turn) must be present — both may be present together, though callers should typically supply just one — and `speech`/`delivery` are forbidden. text_to_speech: `speech` and `delivery` are required and `prompt`, `messages` and `generation` are forbidden. `constraints`/`preferences` steer routing but never select a provider directly.

schemaVersion.description: Contract schema version used to interpret the request payload.

requestId.description: Optional identifier for tracking or correlating this specific execution attempt.

task.description: A descriptor specifying the type of work to be performed. The kind selects which payload the request must carry.

kind.title: TaskKind
kind.description: The operation: 'text_to_text' (prompt-based text generation) or 'text_to_speech' (speech synthesis from text). A consumer built against an older revision rejects a kind it does not know through validation.

prompt.description: A simple, single-turn text prompt used to trigger a response from the AI model.

messages.description: A list of interaction messages for multi-turn conversation or chat-style execution.

items.description: An individual message in a conversation.

content.description: The actual text content of the message.

speech.title: SpeechInput
speech.description: The text_to_speech payload. Required for text_to_speech and forbidden for every other kind.

text.description: Plain text to speak. Markup such as SSML is out of scope.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag of the language to speak, e.g. 'de-AT'.

localeMatch.title: LocaleMatch
localeMatch.description: 'language' (default): the primary language subtag is a hard requirement and the region is a preference. 'exact': the full tag is a hard requirement.

voice.title: SpeechVoice
voice.description: Provider-neutral voice traits. A 'preferred' voice (default) shapes which voice speaks and is never a reason to fail; a 'required' one takes part in routing and is never relaxed silently. Carries no provider voice identifier.

requirement.title: RequirementLevel
requirement.description: 'preferred' (default) or 'required'. A required voice must name at least one trait.

delivery.title: OutputDeliveryRequest
delivery.description: How the result of a non-text task must reach the application (ADR 016). Required for non-text tasks and forbidden for text_to_text, whose output is implicitly inline. A provider never substitutes playback for an artifact or the reverse.

mediaTypes.description: Only valid with 'artifact' delivery: the acceptable media types, always a hard requirement. Absent means the provider chooses and the artifact reports what it produced.

modelProfile.description: Name of the model profile to route within, as configured on the engine. Absent or 'auto' means every registered target, ranked by constraints and preferences alone. A profile is an application-defined, ordered allow-list of targets (provider instances bound to one model each); raw model or provider identifiers are never accepted here. An unknown profile name fails request validation.

generation.description: Optional configuration for fine-tuning how the AI model generates its response.

maxOutputTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in a single response.

temperature.description: Controls the randomness of the output. Range: 0 (most deterministic) to 2 (highest variance).

topP.description: Nucleus sampling parameter for controlling diversity vs focus in the output.

seed.description: A fixed seed for deterministic generation (where supported by the underlying provider).

stop.description: Sequence tokens that should terminate the generation process.

constraints.description: Request-level routing constraints used by the planner.

privacy.description: Privacy requirement or preference for execution placement.

timeoutMs.description: Optional routing timeout budget in milliseconds.

preferences.description: Soft routing preferences used for deterministic provider ordering.

optimizeFor.description: Primary optimization goal when multiple providers remain eligible.

telemetry.description: Execution preferences for tracking usage and performance metrics.

consent.description: Whether the user consents to telemetry collection for this specific request.

level.description: The granularity of the collected metrics (off, minimal, or debug).

tags.description: Optional key-value pairs for correlating telemetry data with specific features or users.

authContextRef.description: A unique identifier used to retrieve credentials from a secure local storage. Raw sensitive keys (API keys, etc.) should NEVER be placed directly in the request payload.
